34593-famous-flyers-and-their-famous-fli.title: Famous Flyers And Their Famous Flights
34593-famous-flyers-and-their-famous-fli.creator: Capt. J. J. Grayson
34593-famous-flyers-and-their-famous-fli.description: A book by Capt. J. J. Grayson. "I'll be down in one second. I'm not going to have you knowing anything I don't know. You're too smart now." The dark head disappeared from the window, reappeared atop the narrow shoulders of its owner at the front door within a few seconds, bobbing about as he leaped down the front steps two at a time. Hal Gregg joined his pal Bob under the maple tree on the Gregg front lawn.

arxiv-2009-14043.title: Online Simple Knapsack with Reservation Costs Journal: Journal of Computer and System Sciences
arxiv-2009-14043.creator: Hans-Joachim Böckenhauer, Elisabet Burjons, Fabian Frei, Juraj Hromkovič, Henri Lotze, Peter Rossmanith
arxiv-2009-14043.description: Abstract In the online simple knapsack problem we are given a knapsack of unit size 1. Items of size smaller or equal to 1 are presented in an iterative fashion and an algorithm has to decide for each item whether to reject or permanently include it into the knapsack without any knowledge about the rest of the instance.

arxiv-2111-08251.title: Enabling Equivariance for Arbitrary Lie Groups
arxiv-2111-08251.creator: Lachlan E. MacDonald, Sameera Ramasinghe, Simon Lucey Australian Institute for Machine Learning University of Adelaide, Australia
arxiv-2111-08251.description: Abstract Although provably robust to translational perturbations, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are known to suffer from extreme performance degradation when presented at test time with more general geometric transformations of inputs. Recently, this limitation has motivated a shift in focus from CNNs to Capsule Networks (CapsNets). However, CapsNets suffer from admitting relatively few theoretical guarantees of invariance.

arxiv-2301-11366.title: Isomorphism classes of cut loci for a cube Thanks: 2000 Mathematics Subject Classification : 52B10, 53C22, 52C30.
arxiv-2301-11366.creator: Donald M. Davis, Manyi Guo
arxiv-2301-11366.description: Abstract . We prove that a face of a cube can be optimally partitioned into 193 connected sets on which the cut locus, or ridge tree, is constant up to isomorphism as a labeled graph. These are 60 connected open sets, curves bounding them, and intersection points of curves. Polynomial equations for the curves are given.

arxiv-2412-18032.title: Supporting Information for “Major Space Weather Risks Identified via Coupled Physics-Engineering-Economic Modeling”
arxiv-2412-18032.creator: Edward J. Oughton 1∗†, Dennies K. Bor 1†, Robert S. Weigel 1, C. Trevor Gaunt 2, Ridvan Dogan 1, Liling Huang 1, Jeffrey J. Love 3, Michael Wiltberger 4 1 Space Weather Lab, George Mason University, Fairfax, VA, USA. 2 University of Cape Town, Cape Town, South Africa. 3 U.S. Geological Survey, Geolo
arxiv-2412-18032.description: Abstract † † journal: AGU Advances \justifying keypoints Space weather poses an important but under-quantified threat to society. A novel physics-engineering-economic framework assesses power grid socio-economic impacts with quantified uncertainties. A daily U.S. loss of 2.04 billion USD is estimated for a 250-year geomagnetic storm (95 percent confidence interval: 1.86 to 2.22 billion USD).

arxiv-2510-03901.title: On the Noise Robustness of Affine Frequency Division Multiplexing: Analysis and Applications
arxiv-2510-03901.creator: Vincent Savaux 1 , Steve Sawadogo 1 2 , Hyeon Seok Rou 3 , Giuseppe Thadeu Freitas de Abreu 3
arxiv-2510-03901.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Vincent Savaux 1 , Steve Sawadogo 1 2 , Hyeon Seok Rou 3 , Giuseppe Thadeu Freitas de Abreu 3. This paper investigates the robustness of affine frequency division multiplexing (AFDM) and orthogonal time frequency space (OTFS) modulation schemes against non-white Gaussian noise, which can model various sources of additive disturbances to the received signal.

pmc-10571549.title: Local Recurrence and Development of Spinal Cord Syndrome during Follow-Up after Surgical Treatment of Metastatic Spine Disease
pmc-10571549.creator: Peter Knöll, Moritz Lenschow, Maximilian Lenz, Volker Neuschmelting, Niklas von Spreckelsen, Sergej Telentschak, Sebastian Olbrück, Maximilian Weber, Johannes Rosenbrock, Peer Eysel, Sebastian G Walter, Dirk Rades, Steven E Schild
pmc-10571549.description: Simple SummaryMetastatic spinal disease is a devastating disease often associated with a reduced quality of life for patients. In these patients, quality of life can be reduced due to peripheral or axial pain, mechanical instability, fractures or neurological impairments. Treatment is interdisciplinary and, in many cases, includes surgery followed by radiotherapy.

pmc-11558268.title: Effects of dopamine β‐hydroxylase inhibition in pressure overload‐induced right ventricular failure
pmc-11558268.creator: Stine Andersen, Julie Sørensen Axelsen, Anders H Nielsen‐Kudsk, Janne Schwab, Caroline D Jensen, Steffen Ringgaard, Asger Andersen, Rowan Smal, Aida Llucià‐Valldeperas, Frances Handoko de Man, Bruno Igreja, Nuno Pires
pmc-11558268.description: Activation of the sympathetic nervous system is observed in pulmonary arterial hypertension patients. This study investigates whether inhibiting the conversion of dopamine into noradrenaline by dopamine β‐hydroxylase (DβH) inhibition with BIA 21‐5337 improved right ventricular (RV) function or remodeling in pressure overload‐induced RV failure. RV failure was induced in male Wistar rats by pulmonary trunk banding (PTB).

pmc-12438161.title: An epidemiological survey of occupational stress among teachers in Tunisia
pmc-12438161.creator: A Aloui, M Bouhoula, E Toulgui, N Ganoun, A Chouchane, M Maoua, A Brahem, H Kalboussi, W Ouanes, O El Maalel, S Jemni, I Kacem, S Chatti
pmc-12438161.description: IntroductionStress is one of the biggest problems facing teachers today. The increasingly demanding nature of their job has also increased pressure levels dramatically. Research shows that teachers are now facing greater day-to-day problems with occupational stress than most other employees.ObjectivesDetermine the prevalence and the caracteristics of the occupational stress among teachers.

pmc-12536407.title: Vibrational Spectroscopic Analysis of Water Absorption in Polyimides and the Correlation with Dielectric Properties at 10 GHz
pmc-12536407.creator: Ririka Sawada, Haonan Liu, Shinji Ando
pmc-12536407.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Unveiling the mechanism behind the relative humidity (RH) dependence of the dielectric properties of polyimides (PIs) in the high-frequency (GHz) range is a crucial challenge in the development of novel low-dielectric thermally stable polymers. Herein, the correlations among the dielectric constant (D k), dissipation factor (D f), water absorption content, and hydrogen-bonding structures of sorbed H2O molecules were precisely analyzed for 15 types of aromatic and semiaromatic PIs based on variable-RH Fourier transform infrared (FT-IR) vibrational spectroscopy.

pmc-12603363.title: Biochemical and anatomical leaf characteristics of oak trees contribute to differences in photosynthetic capacity between leaf habits
pmc-12603363.creator: Mina Momayyezi, Kyra A Prats, Andrew J McElrone, Morgan E Furze, F Xavier Picó, Nadine Ruehr
pmc-12603363.description: Since the leaf is the primary site of photosynthesis, leaf habit impacts the period over which a plant can acquire carbon. However, leaf biochemistry and anatomical characteristics that contribute to differences in photosynthetic capacity between leaf habits deserve further attention. Using a comparative framework, we examined photosynthetic capacity between oak species (Quercus spp.) with different leaf habits.

pmc-12606126.title: A CPEB2/ANGPTL3 feedback loop promotes the progression of podocyte injury in nephrotic syndrome
pmc-12606126.creator: Xin Zheng, Shuibao Chen, Yizhong Chen, Yuling Wu, Fan Lin, Zihua Yu
pmc-12606126.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Podocyte injury is the primary pathology responsible for 70–90% of nephrotic syndrome (NS) in children, a condition closely associated with the aberrant expression of Angiopoietin-like-3 (ANGPTL3). The regulatory mechanism by which ANGPTL3 is upregulated during NS progression remains elusive. In this study, we found that ANGPTL3 can be regulated by Cytoplasmic polyadenylation element binding protein 2 (CPEB2) through translational control, and conversely, CPEB2 can be transcriptionally regulated in response to ANGPTL3 signaling as a feedback loop.

pmc-12656321.title: Enhancing Intrusion Detection for IoT and Sensor Networks Through Semantic Analysis and Self-Supervised Embeddings
pmc-12656321.creator: Yanshen Liu, Yinfeng Guo
pmc-12656321.description: As cyber threats continue to grow in complexity and sophistication, the need for advanced network and sensor security solutions has never been more urgent. Traditional intrusion detection methods struggle to keep pace with the sheer volume of network traffic and the evolving nature of attacks.

pmc-13335737.title: Bionic Solar‐Powered Heavy Metal Trap for Eco‐Friendly Sludge Drying and Simultaneous Electricity Generation
pmc-13335737.creator: Yanlin Li, Jinglan Wang, Hailin Gu, Zhen Yu, Fawei Lin, Cunku Dong, Ningning Cao, Miao Yu
pmc-13335737.description: Sludge, a rapidly accumulating by‐product of wastewater treatment worldwide, holds great potential as an ideal coal substitute following dehydration and drying. Here, we present a solar‐powered heavy metal trap (SPHT) designed for sludge drying and concurrent electricity generation, validated using a PPy‐coated super hydrophilic wood (PPy‐H‐Wood).

pmc-13540678.title: Endoscopic ultrasound–guided gastroenterostomy for the treatment of malignant gastric outlet obstruction in a 3-year-old boy
pmc-13540678.creator: Timothy Adam, Michiel Bronswijk, Karen Pauwelyn, Schalk Van der Merwe
pmc-13540678.description: Background and AimsMalignant gastric outlet obstruction (GOO) is an exceptionally rare and devastating condition in children, for which evidence-based management strategies are lacking. Although recent European guidelines endorse EUS-guided gastroenterostomy (EUS-GE) as an alternative to endoscopic stent placement and surgical gastroenterostomy in adults, its use in pediatrics is virtually unreported, to our knowledge.
